content: Notable OSS DXF viewers: mustafakbaser/DXF-Viewer (MIT, entity rendering, scale indicator, measurement, print, PNG/PDF export, multi-tab, undo/redo); mlightcad/cad-viewer (MIT, WebGL/Three.js, 60fps target, plugin architecture, move/copy/rotate/scale/delete with undo/redo, layer manager, HTML/PDF/SVG export, optional DWG via LibreDWG); vagran/dxf-viewer (MPL-2.0, WebGL, JS, view-only, high performance); georgeh1ll/Easy-DXF-Viewer (Python desktop, measurement-focused).
